中文

体验优化
- 新增右侧栏「**远程连接**」面板(指南页图标为显示器):新建空会话也能打开远端 dsh web —— 补上 0.2.0 遗留的唯一缺口(命令卡片要有对话历史,状态条在 hero 布局里不渲染)
- 面板标题旁显示当前插件版本(桌面端「插件」页对任何插件都不显示版本号)
- 面板内管理隧道:启动 / 断开(两步确认)/ 在侧栏打开 / 在浏览器打开 / 刷新,并且跟随**所选主机**
- 自动发现 `~/.ssh/known_hosts` 里连接过的主机,一键「添加」写进插件配置;`~/.ssh` 全程只读,被哈希的条目只报数量

其他变更
- 面板内可增删插件配置里的主机(两步确认);`~/.ssh/config` 条目只读,但可以「**隐藏**」;发现的主机可以「**忽略**」,「已隐藏」区一键恢复(只写插件配置,不动 `~/.ssh`)
- 命令行 `hosts add` / `hosts rm` 与面板走同一套校验;`hosts` 列表也会列出发现的主机
- 路由失败按语义返回:400(参数)/ 409(已存在)/ 404(未知主机)

---

English

Improvements
- New right sidebar "**remote connections**" panel (a monitor glyph in the guide): open the remote dsh web even in a brand-new session — the last gap left by 0.2.0 (the command card needs conversation history, and the status strip is not rendered in the hero layout)
- The pane shows the live plugin version beside its title (the desktop app's Plugins page renders no version for any plugin)
- Manage the tunnel from the pane: start / disconnect (two-step) / open in sidebar / open in browser / refresh, following the **selected** host
- Hosts from `~/.ssh/known_hosts` are discovered automatically and can be added with one click; `~/.ssh` stays read-only and hashed entries are reported as a count

Chores
- Add or remove the plugin's own host definitions from the pane (two-step); `~/.ssh/config` entries stay read-only but can be **hidden**, and a discovered candidate can be **ignored** — the 已隐藏 section restores either (the plugin's own config only, never `~/.ssh`)
- CLI `hosts add` / `hosts rm` share the panel's validation, and `hosts` also lists discovered hosts
- Route failures answer with their meaning: 400 (input) / 409 (exists) / 404 (unknown host)
